theory: State $b\ne0$ for the domain formula for $y=\arcsin(bx)$: when $b=0$, the domain is all real numbers. State $a\ne0$ for the two-asymptote formula for $y=a\arctan x+c$; when $a=0$, the graph is the constant line $y=c$, not a curve with two distinct asymptotes.
